idea-plugin.name: Cypress Radar
idea-plugin.description:
Cypress Radar displays Cypress test health inline in your spec files, powered by the Cypress Cloud Data Extract API.

For each it() or test() call, a color-coded block appears above the line showing the historical pass rate and clickable links to failing runs:

  • Green — 100% pass rate
  • Yellow — 75–99% pass rate (flaky)
  • Red — below 75% or failing in the most recent run
  • Gray — no historical data yet
  • Blue — dynamic title that cannot be statically matched

Each block shows passes/total (rate%), failed in runs: #1234 #1235. Run numbers link directly to the Cypress Cloud test replay.

Supports it('title'), it("title"), it(`title`), and multi-line forms. Results are cached for 5 minutes.

Configure by placing a flake-guard.json file in your project root:

{ "provider": "cypress-cloud", "apiToken": "YOUR_DATA_EXTRACT_API_TOKEN" }

The API token must be a Cypress Cloud Data Extract API key (Enterprise feature). Generate one at cloud.cypress.io → Integrations → Data Extract API.
